what_it_is: No. 1 Base Repair Depot (1 BRD) of the Indian Air Force at Kanpur is the service's oldest aircraft overhaul establishment, responsible for depot-level maintenance, repair, overhaul and upgrade of frontline aircraft types and rotables. Historically the 'mother depot' for transport-aircraft overhaul, it anchors IAF Maintenance Command's deep-repair capability for the An-32 fleet alongside 3 BRD Chandigarh.
india_angle: 1 BRD is central to India's An-32 sustainment: public reporting describes an IAF roadmap to overhaul the An-32 fleet in India at roughly 15 aircraft per overhaul cycle through 1 BRD Kanpur and 3 BRD Chandigarh, reducing dependence on Ukrainian OEM support. The depot also featured in presidential colour presentations as a heritage establishment.
intelligence_assessment: The depot's role is officially documented, but throughput, cost and fleet-availability outcomes of the indigenised An-32 overhaul programme are not published in detail. Its importance to this atlas is as the institutional backbone of Indian military-aerospace MRO - watch An-32 overhaul completion rates as the key capability metric.
